retrievalProfile.description: A side-profile studio portrait in warm sepia tones featuring a subject in a fedora and suit, utilizing elegant script typography for a classic R&B or soul aesthetic.
triggerTerms: warm monochrome studio photography with script text
excludeWhen: modern minimalist sans-serif layouts are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, side-profile photograph of a man wearing a dark fedora and a suit, rendered in a grainy, warm sepia-monochrome palette. The lighting is directional, creating deep shadows on the back of the head and neck while highlighting the facial features. Elegant, flowing script text is positioned in the lower-left quadrant, overlapping the dark clothing.
coreVisualRelationships: The subject's profile gaze creates a strong horizontal vector across the upper half.
The dark mass of the suit and hat anchors the right and top edges.
The light-colored script text provides a high-contrast focal point against the dark torso.
The grainy texture unifies the photographic and typographic elements.
coreInvariants: Warm sepia or monochromatic brown color grading
Presence of a brimmed hat (fedora style)
Low-key lighting with significant shadow areas

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned on the right two-thirds of the frame, captured from the chest up in profile.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the brim of the hat serve as the primary anchors.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the face, follows the profile line down to the text, and then moves across the dark suit.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant dark negative space on the left side provides room for typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep umber and dark brown for shadows and clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm cream and light tan for skin highlights and background glow.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between the highlights and deep shadows.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Elegant formal script with calligraphic flourishes.
letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thick and thin lines
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single script family used in two sizes to create hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the formal calligraphic flourishes and high contrast.
Provides a similar fluid, connected script feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a side-profile studio portrait of a man in a fedora and suit, lit with warm directional light, rendered in a grainy sepia monochrome style with a dark background on the left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply two lines of elegant script text in off-white in the lower-left area, ensuring the text slightly overlaps the dark suit.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly monochromatic sepia?
Is the subject in a clear side-profile?
Is the typography a formal script?
Is the grain texture visible across the entire frame?

postGenerationChecks: Check for correct sepia color balance.
Ensure the script text is legible against the dark background.
Verify the profile silhouette is sharp and recognizable.
Confirm the film grain does not obscure facial details.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Profile + Fedora + Sepia Grade + Script Overlay = Classic Soul Aesthetic
